verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a live financial Model where users can check every number, and outputs print their lineage back to the source line, which supports drill-down to source records. It forecasts revenue, costs, and cash from ledger actuals, but the evidence never explicitly describes P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow statement views. missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement views; documented click-through drill-down from any statement figure to individual ledger transactions; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the model produces P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow views with drill-down from any figure to its source records

citations.quote: Each one prints its lineage back to the source line.
you can open that Model, check every number, and change the assumptions yourself
Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from what drives your business.
Bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet.
